learning_outcomes.text: Identification, definition, and use of concepts from fundamental sciences specific to the field of engineering.
Use of graphic principles and tools for describing and designing mechanical systems and processes.
Selection, installation, operation, and maintenance of systems in the field of mechanical engineering.

Analysis of technical documentation for mechanical engineering systems and equipment based on their type, structure, and intended use, and their manufacturing technological processes and operational technologies.
Technical-economic and financial justification for entrepreneurial decisions and technological design.
Implementation and coordination of the integrated quality-environment management system.
Selection of the optimal variant based on technical, economic, and technological criteria.
Transition from project as theoretical justification documentation to project as execution documentation.
Adherence to the principles, norms, and values of the professional code of ethics by adopting a rigorous, efficient, and responsible work strategy in problem-solving and decision-making.
Application of effective relationship-building and teamwork techniques in a multidisciplinary team, across various hierarchical levels, within the work group—specific project management.
Appropriate use of effective lifelong learning methods and techniques; appropriate use of information, oral and written communication in a European language.
Appropriate use of standard evaluation criteria and methods to assess the quality, advantages, and limitations of marketing and management concepts, methods, and theories.

syllabus_topics: Joints between hubs and shafts - Transverse joints (by keys/pins)
Joints between hubs and shafts - Longitudinal joints by keys
Joints between hubs and shafts - Splined joints
Joints between hubs and shafts - Cylindrical elastic joints by interference fit on surfaces
Joints between hubs and shafts - Pressed conical joints
Sliding bearings - Bearings with boundary and mixed friction
Sliding bearings - Lubricant supply systems and specific seals
Rolling bearings - Geometry and kinematics of rolling bearings
Rolling bearings - Dynamic capacity of rolling bearings, considering contact fatigue
Rolling bearings - Durability of rolling bearings and influences on durability
Rolling bearings - Lubrication of rolling bearings
Joints with elastic elements - Springs. Types. Materials. Technologies
Joints with elastic elements - Helical compression spring
Joints with elastic elements - Bending springs
Joints with elastic elements - Torsion springs
Joints with elastic elements - Rubber springs
Joints with elastic elements - Shock absorbers
Bearing capacity of cylindrical interference fit joints
Project theme: Transmission with cylindrical, conical gears, coupling and housing. Selection of the constructive variant
Establishing transmission ratios and their distribution. Calculation of input coupling
Design of shafts, keys and splines
Preparation of execution and assembly documentation
teaching_methods: Direct teaching method, blackboard, engaging students based on their prior knowledge from supported curriculum disciplines
PowerPoint presentations, using a video projector
Provided course material, including PowerPoint presentations
Classical teaching and use of video projector/online
Classical teaching and discussions with students/online
Classical teaching, video projector use, and real parts/online
Classical teaching, with video projector and use of constructive laboratory examples/online
Computer work, after sketching on paper /online
Presentation of solutions via video projector/online
assessment_rules: To pass the course, students must obtain a minimum grade of 5 for the exam, and for the Laboratory and Project components.
